description: grid-api rejected a service-to-service call for a bad/missing X-Service-Token on an internal-only endpoint (validate-word / resolve-word). These endpoints sit off public ingress, so a rejection means a legitimate caller's WORD_VALIDATE_SERVICE_TOKEN drifted - not an attacker. This is the direct signal for the token-drift class (the 2026-07-14 co-op outage), unsampled and earlier than the caller-side error.

annotations.summary: grid-api is rejecting internal service-token calls
annotations.description: {{$value}} service-auth rejections in 5m on grid-api's internal endpoints (validate-word / resolve-word). A legitimate caller (game-api, survey-api) is presenting a stale/missing WORD_VALIDATE_SERVICE_TOKEN - the shared token has drifted between services. Co-op word validation and word resolution are broken. Fix: re-sync the token across bliss-game-api-env / wordsparrow-api-env (and the survey caller) and roll the affected pods.
